descriptionHTML:
Want to strengthen your connection with the Quran? Try the Al Quran app, used by 8M+ people worldwide and supporting 66 languages. Completely free & no ads!

Understand every verse with Tafsir, word-by-word meanings, and grammar, listen to beautiful recitations, follow tajweed, and read from familiar Mushaf pages.

Discover how this app helps you connect with the Quran more meaningfully:

Understand the Quran in your language
● Study the Quran by studying 170+ translations & tafsirs of the Quran in 60+ languages: English, Indonesian, Bangla, Hindi, Urdu, German, Chinese, French, Italian, Malay, Russian, Spanish, Tamil, and many more!
● Access 8 Arabic tafsirs (including Ibn Kathir, Tabari) with I‘rab, word meanings, and Asbabun Nuzul.

Read word by word analysis & translations
● Read word by word translations of the Quran in 15+ languages, including English, Indonesian, Bangla, German, Hindi, Ingush, Malay, Russian, Tamil, Turkish and Urdu
● Study and analyse Word Root/Lemma, Grammar, Morphology, Occurrences in different forms and Verb Forms to dive in more depth. Helpful to learn & understand Quranic Arabic

Build a Quran reading habit
● Set daily reading goals and gradually increase them
● Track your daily & weekly reading activity effortlessly
● Earn badges for completing streak milestones and exploring app features

Listen to Quran recitations
● 80+ reciters audio recitations with audio translation in 10+ languages
● Reciter Options: Mishary Al Afasy, Husary, Ayman Suwaid, Abdur Rahman As-Sudais and many others
● Powerful Audio System with repeat, group playback of verses function to aid in Quran Memorisation/Quran Hifz
● Reciters tagged based on recitation types: Murattal, Mujawwad, Translation, WBW
● Arabic Audio commentary and Quran audio translation in Bangla, English, Urdu others

Learn brief of the Juz and Surah
● Get a quick summary of every Juz
● See surah summaries and virtues at a glance

Follow Quran reading plan
● Plan your Khatmah of the Quran using the Quran Planner
● Choose a standard 29 or 30-day plan, or create a custom schedule to reach your Quran reading goals at your own pace

Read from Mushaf Mode
● Recite Quran in Mushaf mode to have the same experience when reciting from a hard-copy Quran in your preferred Mushaf script
● Available Mushaf scripts: Madani, Naskh Indopak, Qaloon, Shemerly, Warsh

Bookmark necessary verses and take notes
● Bookmark ayahs to your own Collections and keep track of the last read ayah using Pins
● Start reading from where you left off using auto Last Reads
● Reflect and take notes for each ayah
● Sync library across multiple devices and even share with others using import/export

Find any verse or topic easily
● Powerful search with highlights to quickly find any Surah, Ayah, etc
● Explore Quran by topics & read the ayahs related to a topic together

Various other options
● Read Tafsirs in Tafsir view
● Recite with colour-coded Tajweed
● Quran Dictionary: See the list of roots for different Arabic alphabets
● Various fonts and multiple themes, including Night mode
● Autoscroll feature
● Copy & Share the verses
● All features can be used offline

Download the ad-free Quran app and start your journey to a deeper understanding of the Quran!

Share and recommend this beautiful app to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and the hereafter.

Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said: "Whoever calls people to right guidance will have a reward like that of those who follow him..." [Sahih Muslim: 2674]

📱Developed by Greentech Apps Foundation (GTAF)
Website: https://gtaf.org

Please keep us in your sincere duas. Jazakumullahu khairan
